entries.9e838706788f81d4: This business manufactures and sells printing inks, such as flexo inks, gravure inks, metal inks and offset inks, for markets in the Americas. Under the US holding company THE INX GROUP LIMITED, INX International Ink Co. and others conduct business in the United States, Canada, Mexico and Brazil. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥101,117 million, the largest of the reportable segments.
entries.a0adddd7bd659e06: This business produces and sells materials that apply foundational technologies such as pigment dispersion, developed in the printing ink business, for the markets of Japan, Asia, the Americas and Europe. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥20,331 million.
entries.a0bf47120d351701: This business manufactures and sells printing inks, such as flexo inks, gravure inks, metal inks, newspaper inks and offset inks, for markets in Asia. It has production and sales bases in India, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, China, Thailand, Bangladesh, Cambodia, the Philippines and others, and subsidiaries in Australia and New Zealand are also included in this segment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥56,008 million.
entries.b3f283db15f61786: This business manufactures and sells printing inks for the Japanese market and also purchases and sells printing equipment, such as printing plate-making materials and printing plate-making related equipment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥49,318 million.

It has bases in Spain, the United Kingdom, France, Germany and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥20,861 million.
entries.e45343be31063fb4: A leading printing ink manufacturer and chemical company that makes and sells printing inks in Japan, Asia, the Americas and Europe, and also handles functional materials such as inkjet inks.
entries.ecacf3ec2dfeaafc: For the Japanese market, it manufactures and sells flexo inks, gravure inks, newspaper inks, offset inks and others. Amounts are not separately disclosed by segment.
entries.ed43af444df6c0e4: For the Japanese market, it purchases and sells printing plate-making materials and printing plate-making related equipment and provides total solutions covering the entire printing process. Amounts are not separately disclosed by segment.
entries.f6f11b8aa20bd0c4: This business mainly serves the Japanese market, purchasing and selling chemical products, producing and selling display services, and purchasing and selling brand protection solutions. This category is not included in the reportable segments. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥10,029 million.
